## PRODUCT TITLE
Example Typeface - Modern Display

## PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
Example Typeface is a modern display typeface with clear geometric forms and a confident rhythm for prominent lettering. Use it for logos, posters, packaging, editorial headlines, and social graphics when the design needs a readable statement with a contemporary voice.

The supplied package includes OTF and TTF desktop font files for compatible font-enabled applications. Install the files in the usual way on Windows or Mac and use them in supported design and layout software. Character coverage and additional features should be copied here only from the supplied product facts.

Example Typeface brings a direct, structured finish to brand names, titles, labels, and other short display compositions.
